summary: 6 target claims evaluated across brief sections 2A-2D/Risks (section 1 out of scope, single-source; section 3 an explicit unsourced judgment call, untouched). Stronger-original: 4 (LeKiwi buildability, Ch.8 dynamics-gap risk note, Bittle 'not a dead project' lineage, blanket-feasibility core buildability) — two of these strengthened rather than merely surviving. Stronger-counter: 2 (SO-ARM100 headline cost, Bittle on-device-IK framing). Disproven/false as literally stated: 3 (SO-ARM100 ~$115 single-arm figure describes a bare-frame component not a full build; Bittle 'genuinely exercises IK, not pre-baked motions' contradicted by direct firmware inspection showing offline/design-time-only IK use; the narrow claim that the exact 2020-Kickstarter Bittle hardware remains the actively sold product, now discontinued). Unresolved: 3 (SO-ARM100 'thousands of builders'; LeKiwi $660 headline vs. lower $482-499 reference BOM; independence of the robotsthatexist.com/growbotics.ai aggregator sources). Blanket hobbyist-feasibility tone/degree corrected by independent friction reports without reversing underlying buildability.
